capacity_recovery_policy: One fresh recovery only after explicit provider-capacity interruption, with the same frozen skill, model, binary and permissions. An interrupted learning setup requires rebuilding its learning/recurrence pair. Completed valid outcomes are never retried. Originals remain in custody.
